translations.web: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
translations.bsb: My people are bent on turning from Me. Though they call to the Most High, He will by no means exalt them.

translations.asv: And my people are bent on backsliding from me: though they call them to him that is on high, none at all will exalt him.
